tasks.command: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const { Client } = require('pg'); const client = new Client({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl: process.env.DATABASE_URL.includes('localhost') ? false : { rejectUnauthorized: false } }); client.connect().then(async()=>{ const res = await client.query(\"SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('users','bookings','settings') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position\"); console.log(JSON.stringify(res.rows)); await client.end(); }).catch(err=>{ console.error(err.stack); process.exit(1); });"
